_doc: Canonical-feature lineage census (48-dim, schema v5.0). Source-verified table + optional frozen-XAU smoke. Dim/version are read from the live schema, never re-declared here — the hardcoded '39-dim, schema v4.0' text survived the v5.0 bump and described an artifact that no longer existed (corrected 2026-09-05).

features.formula: identity or T-003 proxy high-low if all-zero
features.pit: same-bar; proxy mutates volume column in-place when dead
features.mutation_risk: T-003 silent rename under same key
features.name: volume

features.formula: both sweep directions in short window on causal liquidity_sweep
features.pit: production structure graph uses causal last_swing refs (available_at=t+k); rolling window of past sweeps only
features.name: double_sweep

features.formula: EMA(close, span=fast) — pipeline uses ma aliases / ewm
features.name: ema_fast

features.pit: depends on EMA history; ATR-gated NaN during warmup
features.name: ema_spread

features.formula: sign of MA relationship / rsi_state-like encoding to {-1,0,1}
features.name: trend_bias

features.pit: causal lookback; ATR-gated warmup NaN possible
features.name: momentum_score

features.formula: atr / close or pipeline volatility ratio
features.name: volatility_ratio

features.formula: macd_line - macd_signal (FM-049) -- the DECLARED formula, unchanged from v3.0
features.note: v4.0 rename of the v3.0 `macd_hist` entry -- same math, index moved 18->18 (this identity) while the z-scored value it used to silently carry moved to its own slot, macd_hist_z (index 19).
features.name: macd_hist_raw

features.note: v4.0 new slot (index 19) -- what v3.0's single `macd_hist` column actually EMITTED (compute_normalization overwrote it in place); now has its own canonical identity distinct from macd_hist_raw.
features.name: macd_hist_z

features.formula: sweep high/low vs causal last_swing refs (shift(1))
features.pit: causal last_swing_*_price; bar t uses info through t
features.name: liquidity_sweep

features.formula: centered pivot then delayed publication: centered.shift(k), k=SWING_WINDOW=2
features.name: swing_high

features.formula: centered pivot then delayed publication: centered.shift(k), k=SWING_WINDOW=2
features.name: swing_low

features.pit: depends on causal swing last prices
features.name: higher_high

features.pit: depends on causal swing last prices
features.name: lower_low

features.note: v4.0 rename (feature_schema.py:89, Semantic Layer Certification Audit 2026-07-31, Tier 1 items 1-2): this entry was `wick_size` in v3.0 -- pure identity rename, math never changed (always high-low, never a wick magnitude -- see F-046 / candle_math.py). `wick_size` survives only as a read-side alias for historical records (SCHEMA_V3_ALIASES); never emitted.
features.name: candle_range

features.formula: tercile of ATR rolling percentile rank (N=200); production bind FC1-D
features.pit: rolling rank uses past+current only (min_periods=1); prefix-invariant interior
features.note: FC1-D 2026-07-11: production was GLOBAL_BATCH (non-PIT prefix ~43%). Adjudication FC-0.5 selected rolling N=200 causal; global preserved as volatility_regime_global_batch research/legacy only. Semantic is local ATR-percentile tercile context, not latent Regime Detection.
features.name: volatility_regime

features.formula: session bucket from hour/tz assumptions → SESSION_MAP float
features.name: session

related_identities.name: displacement_atr_ratio
related_identities.role: distinct CRT range/ATR multiple, historically emitted under 'disp_strength' — renamed off pipeline names by F-050/CH-002

related_identities.name: disp_strength_atr_rescale
related_identities.role: distinct scoring_engine as-wired quantity FM-020/atr_rel — registered + routed by GD-004 closure 2026-07-11

features.note: F-050 (FM-028 emission rename) + GD-004 (FM-029 registration): name collisions closed; this row is FM-020 only
features.name: disp_strength

features.formula: FM-021 pipeline retest vs EMA/ATR; CRT has FM-027 displacement_retrace
features.name: retest_depth

features.formula: bars since last retest event flag
features.name: candles_since_retest

features.formula: ATR-normalised distance to nearest liquidity level (causal swing refs)
features.impl: feature_pipeline liquidity block v3 + derived_math (FC1-A refs)
features.pit: depends on causal last_swing / BOS levels + shift(1)
features.name: liquidity_distance

features.formula: tanh(signed ATR distance from close to nearest UNMITIGATED order-block edge); OB = last opposite-colour candle before a causal-swing break, k=SWING_WINDOW=2
features.pit: break events use detect_causal_swings(bars[:i], k) — no lookahead (order_block.py:38-50); window grows only to bar i
features.note: schema v5.0 (F-076); PIT classified 2026-09-05, classification only — grants no closure and no authority
features.name: order_block_distance

features.formula: tanh(signed ATR distance from close to nearest UNFILLED fair-value-gap near edge); 3-candle test bars[i-1].high < bars[i+1].low (bullish) / bars[i-1].low > bars[i+1].high (bearish)
features.pit: zone is STAMPED at the middle candle (formed_at_index) but only becomes detectable once bars[i+1] has closed — publication lag 1; the interior loop range(1, n-1) never reads past the caller's window, so the EMITTED value at bar i uses only bars <= i (fvg.py:23-37)
features.note: schema v5.0 (F-076); the delayed publication is on the zone's backdated stamp, not on the emitted distance. PIT classified 2026-09-05
features.name: fvg_distance

features.formula: tanh(signed ATR distance to nearest un-retested BREAKER — an order block whose far edge was fully closed through, polarity flipped), k=SWING_WINDOW=2
features.pit: reuses order_block._find_break_events (causal swings, bars[:i]); breaker requires a LATER close-through, so it is strictly backward-looking
features.name: breaker_distance

features.formula: tanh(signed ATR distance to the BODY-only inner zone of the active OB origin whose outer zone was already touched), k=SWING_WINDOW=2
features.pit: same causal break-event scan as order_block; the outer-zone touch it gates on is a past event
features.note: schema v5.0 (F-076); deliberately a DIFFERENT distance from order_block_distance, not an alias. PIT classified 2026-09-05
features.name: mitigation_block_distance

features.formula: tanh(signed ATR distance from close to the most recently CLOSED D1 parent's high); 0.0 before the first D1 parent closes
features.pit: reads parent_history[-1] = the last COMPLETED daily candle, never the forming one (levels.py:26-35); reference is a prior calendar unit, so it is delayed relative to the bar that publishes it
features.note: schema v5.0 (F-076); NOT CALENDAR_SAME_BAR — session/hour_of_day derive from the bar's OWN timestamp, this derives from a previous completed day. PIT classified 2026-09-05
features.name: pdh_distance

features.formula: tanh(signed ATR distance from close to the most recently CLOSED D1 parent's low); 0.0 before the first D1 parent closes
features.pit: reads parent_history[-1] = the last COMPLETED daily candle, never the forming one (levels.py:26-35)
features.name: pdl_distance

features.formula: tanh(signed ATR distance to the most recent member of an EQUAL-HIGHS cluster — 2+ confirmed swing highs within tolerance_atr=0.1 * atr), k=SWING_WINDOW=2
features.pit: collect_causal_swings only returns pivots confirmed by k closed later bars (_geometry.py:79-101)
features.note: schema v5.0 (F-076); cluster extension of the single-swing FM-025/026 liquidity reading. PIT classified 2026-09-05
features.name: eqh_distance

features.formula: tanh(signed ATR distance to the most recent member of an EQUAL-LOWS cluster — 2+ confirmed swing lows within tolerance_atr=0.1 * atr), k=SWING_WINDOW=2
features.pit: collect_causal_swings only returns pivots confirmed by k closed later bars (_geometry.py:79-101)
features.name: eql_distance

features.formula: break_of_structure if sign(break_of_structure) != sign(trend_bias) and both nonzero, else 0.0
features.pit: stateless algebra over two already-classified canonical slots; inherits the weaker parent (break_of_structure = STRUCTURE_WITH_CAUSAL_SWING), trend_bias is CAUSAL_DERIVED
features.note: schema v5.0 (F-076); adds NO new BOS/CHoCH detection state machine (choch.py:6-15). Registered FM-083 and STATEFUL in the ontology, but named in NO resolver `when:` clause. PIT classified 2026-09-05
features.name: change_of_character

authority: Research/architecture only. No economic claims. No formula changes.
